Name: 市政中心
Text: 主要建筑，建筑等级决定其他建筑的数量。
desc_en: Your main building. Its level affects the number, type, and maximum level of other buildings.

Name: 英雄祭坛
desc_en: You can hire and train Heroes here. Further upgrades reduce Hero revival times.

Name: 兵营
Text: 可生产不同兵种，具有一定的警戒范围，会自动出兵防御。
desc_en: Produces a variety of Troops. Level up to increase maximum troop amount and reduce hiring time. Troops deploy automatically when under attack.

Name: 金矿
Text: 金币的产出建筑，有临时库存空间。
desc_en: Produces Gold. Level up to increase production and storage space.

Name: 水晶矿
Text: 水晶的产出建筑，有临时库存空间。
desc_en: Produces Mana. Level up to increase production and storage space.

Name: 金库
Text: 用于存储金币的建筑，与面板上的金币数量关联。
desc_en: Stores harvested Gold. Level up to increase storage space.

Name: 仓库
Text: 用于存储水晶的建筑，与面板上的水晶数量关联。
desc_en: Stores harvested Mana. Level up to increase storage space.

Name: 初级塔
Text: 初级防御塔。10级后，可进阶为高级炮台。
desc_en: Basic defense tower. Attacks enemy troops. Can be upgraded into specialized towers after Lv 10.

Name: 弓箭塔
Text: 擁有单体攻击能力的炮台。
desc_en: An upgraded version of the Lv 10 Basic Tower. It attacks single targets rapidly.

Name: 魔法塔
Text: 可同时攻击多个目标的炮台。
desc_en: An upgraded version of the Lv 10 Basic Tower. It attacks multiple targets at once.

Name: 竞技场
Text: 通过参加英雄竞技获得排名，根据排名可获得不同的奖励。
desc_en: Join the Arena to earn a place on the Rankings and win great rewards!

Name: 魔法屋
Text: 可生产与升级道具，道具可在进攻时使用。
desc_en: Researches equipments that are essential for raids.

Name: 石墙
Text: 用于防御的建筑，可影响进攻方的路线。
desc_en: Your first line of defense. Place them strategically to hinder the enemy's advance.

Name: 爆炸陷阱
Text: 敌方接近时，会产生爆炸效果。效果触发后，建筑会消失。
desc_en: Explodes and deals damage to enemy Troops within range. Ineffective against flying units.

Name: 英雄底座
Text: 用于放置英雄。有一定的警戒范围。
desc_en: Heroes are positioned here to defend against incoming attacks. You can also send them out for raids.Level up to increase the assigned Hero's attributes and patrol range.

Name: 训练场
desc_en: Train low grade Heroes to transform them into high grade Heroes. Upgrade troops to obtain stronger troop types.

Name: 墓碑
desc_en: A gravestone that appears whenever a troop dies.

Name: 火炮塔
Text: 对目标位置，造成範圍伤害。
desc_en: An upgraded version of the Basic Tower. Its cannon deals damage to all ground enemies around its target.

Name: 竞技场建筑
Text: 用于竞技场的建筑（同市政中心数据）。
desc_en: Glory Hall

Name: 英雄陷阱
Text: 英雄单位接近时，会产生爆炸效果。效果触发后，建筑会消失。
desc_en: Explodes and deals DMG equal to 10% Max HP to enemy Heroes within range. Place more Hero Traps together for a devastating effect. Ineffective against flying units.

Name: 部落建築
Text: 升級可提升圖騰的購買空間。
desc_en: A building required to join or create a Guild. Join a Guild to participate in Guild events and win rewards.

Name: 铁匠铺
Text: 锻造装备的建筑，完成铁匠铺发布任务，可获得英雄装备。
desc_en: Forge and manage Gear here. Deploy Heroes to complete the tasks here to get Gear as rewards.

Name: 道具屋
Text: 用于存放游戏中的道具物品。
desc_en: A building used to store items.
